headlines.title: SK Hynix’s Profit Jumped 632% as AI Eats the World’s Memory
headlines.summary: SK hynix just posted the kind of numbers that make investors question everything they thought they knew about commodity chip stocks, but the real story lives in what the CEO said about demand through 2029 and why net income badly missed estimates despite a historic quarter.

headlines.title: SK Hynix Jumps 8% After a 632% Profit Surge and a $45 Billion Shareholder Pledge. Micron and SanDisk Are Riding Along.
headlines.summary: SK Hynix shattered profit records overnight, and the ripple hit Micron, SanDisk, and Western Digital before US markets opened. Whether this premarket surge marks a genuine memory recovery or just a 60 trillion won promise doing heavy lifting is the question every memory investor needs to answer before October 29.

headlines.title: Micron Stock Pops as Rival SK Hynix Fuels AI Frenzy With Two Bombshells
headlines.summary: Micron stock was rising as SK Hynix earnings fueled enthusiasm for memory-chip companies.

description: Micron Technology, Inc. engages in the provision of semiconductor memory and storage products in the United States, Taiwan, Mainland China, other Asia Pacific countries, Japan, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Cloud Memory Business Unit, Core Data Center Business Unit, Mobile and Client Business Unit, and Automotive and Embedded Business Unit segments. The company provides dynamic random access memory (DRAM) products, including High-Bandwidth Memory, doublie data rate, low-power DRAM, and graphics DRAM products; NAND products comprising solid state drives, managed NAND, and multi-chip packages; and NOR products. The company sells its products under the Micron brand name and private labels through its own direct sales force, sales or representative offices, as well as through distributors, retailers, and independent sales representatives. Micron Technology, Inc. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Boise, Idaho.
